ministries.title: Sunday School
ministries.description: Focuses on the spiritual nurturing of children, bringing them up in the knowledge and fellowship of Jesus Christ and His Church. Following a comprehensive curriculum jointly published by the Oriental Orthodox Churches, classes span from Pre-primary through Higher Secondary levels, concluding with the Sunday School Final Certificate (SSFC) examination. Dedicated teachers actively bridge cultural diversity while raising spiritually nourished, promising global citizens.

ministries.title: MGOCSM
ministries.audience: High School & University Students / Academic Youth
ministries.description: The Mar Gregorios Orthodox Christian Student Movement (MGOCSM) is the oldest Christian student organisation in India and a vibrant wing in our parish. Operating on the three-fold path of Worship, Study, and Service, it deepens the spiritual life of students, providing vital pastoral care, academic mentoring, and fellowship for students and young migrants settling in New Zealand.

ministries.title: OCYM (Orthodox Christian Youth Movement)
ministries.description: The youth wing of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church provides dynamic Christian leadership and active witness in church and society. OCYM empowers young adults to engage with contemporary challenges while cultivating a life of deep prayer, community outreach, conferences, cottage prayer meetings, and annual charity projects.

ministries.title: Martha Mariam Samajam
ministries.audience: All women and mothers of the parish
ministries.description: The vibrant women's fellowship of the Church named after its patron, the Blessed Virgin Saint Mary. Operating under the sacred motto 'Prayer, Act & Shine' (Prarthikkuka, Pravarthikkuka, Prakasikkuka), the Samajam fosters deep spiritual growth, scripture study, charity missions, and leadership training for women across the parish community.

ministries.title: SDOF (St. Dionysius Orthodox Fellowship)
ministries.description: A dedicated parish fellowship group established to strengthen spiritual bonds, community outreach, and mutual support among parish families. SDOF spearheads family retreats, devotional seminars, parish welfare initiatives, and fellowship gatherings under the guidance of our Vicar.

ministries.title: SJOF (St. Joseph Orthodox Fellowship)
ministries.description: A devoted spiritual fellowship of the parish named after St. Joseph, uniting families in continuous intercession, spiritual growth, Christian charity, and mutual encouragement. SJOF coordinates family retreats, supportive visits, and regular parish fellowship meetings under the guidance of the Vicar.

ministries.title: Prayer Groups
ministries.audience: All parish families across Auckland regions
ministries.description: Regional ward cottage prayer groups that gather regularly at parishioners' homes for evening prayers (Sandhya Namaskaram), intercession, Bible study, and warm Christian fellowship. These neighborhood prayer cells keep families deeply connected and provide support during life milestones and bereavements.
